# Reference samples

Extracted by `scripts/extract_refs.py` from archived dev.twitter.com pages.
JSON is re-serialised after a lenient parse (the docs showed escapes unescaped); XML is verbatim.
Files ending `.broken` did not parse (truncated doc examples) and are not used by tests.
